capabilities: download the public Letterboxd RSS feed for a username
create one note per watched movie in a chosen folder
run sync manually or on a timer
forward-link new watch dates via the Reflect Forward Linker plugin
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is a one-way download of a public RSS feed, not two-way sync; no Letterboxd sign-in is required.
extras: The README includes a privacy note: it only fetches the public RSS feed for the given username and sends no vault contents or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a user's Letterboxd watch history into per-movie notes.

relations.evidence: the plugin also works with the separately installed Reflect Forward Linker plugin inside Obsidian

summary: RSS-based importer that turns a Letterboxd user's public watch feed into one Obsidian note per movie, on demand or on a timer.
